# SoraToastProvider

Hosts the queue of dismissible notifications that `useToast()` adds to.

|  |  |
| --- | --- |
| Category | feedback |
| Import | `import { SoraToastProvider } from '@your-scope/ui'` |
| Direct import | `import SoraToastProvider from '@your-scope/ui/components/SoraToastProvider'` |
| Source | [`packages/ui/src/components/feedback/SoraToastProvider.vue`](../../packages/ui/src/components/feedback/SoraToastProvider.vue) |

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `duration` | `number` | `5000` | Default lifetime of a toast in milliseconds (`0` = until dismissed). |
| `max` | `number` | `3` | Toasts shown at once; the rest wait in the queue. |
| `placement` | `'top-start' \| 'top' \| 'top-end' \| 'bottom-start' \| 'bottom' \| 'bottom-end'` | `'bottom-end'` | Corner (or edge) of the viewport, in logical terms. |
| `label` | `string` |  | Accessible name of the notification region. |

## Slots

| Slot | Slot props | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `default` |  | Application content; anything inside can call `useToast()`. |

## Attributes

The notification region (`<section>`); the slot content is rendered next to it, unwrapped.

## Keyboard

- Toast buttons are ordinary buttons in the page tab order.
- Focus or hover inside the region pauses auto-dismissal.

## Accessibility

- A labelled region with two persistent live regions: polite (`role="status"`) and assertive (`role="alert"`, for `urgent` toasts).
- Every toast has a dismiss button; `duration: 0` keeps it until dismissed.
- The region is a manual popover in the top layer; while a modal dialog is open it is inert, so use an inline SoraAlert for feedback inside dialogs.

## Styling

- `.sora-toast-region`, `.sora-toast`, `.sora-toast__title`, `.sora-toast__description`
- `data-placement`, `data-color`

## Example

From the gallery ([`apps/gallery/src/demos/FeedbackDemos.vue`](../../apps/gallery/src/demos/FeedbackDemos.vue)), where it is type-checked and covered by the end-to-end tests. `t()` is the gallery's translation function; the state it binds is declared in that file.

```vue
<div class="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
  <SoraButton
    variant="outline"
    color="neutral"
    data-testid="toast-show"
    @click="
      toast.add({
        title: t('demo.toast.title'),
        description: t('demo.toast.body'),
        color: 'success',
        action: { label: t('demo.toast.undo'), onClick: () => {} },
      })
    "
  >
    {{ t('demo.toast.show') }}
  </SoraButton>
  <SoraButton
    variant="outline"
    color="error"
    data-testid="toast-urgent"
    @click="
      toast.add({
        title: t('demo.toast.urgent.title'),
        description: t('demo.toast.urgent.body'),
        color: 'error',
        urgent: true,
      })
    "
  >
    {{ t('demo.toast.urgent') }}
  </SoraButton>
  <SoraButton
    variant="outline"
    color="neutral"
    data-testid="toast-persistent"
    @click="toast.add({ title: t('demo.toast.title'), duration: 0 })"
  >
    {{ t('demo.toast.persistent') }}
  </SoraButton>
</div>
```
